name: amnesia
description: Keeps what compaction drops: appends the exact details the summary lost, and gives the agent a recall tool over everything earlier in the session.

budgetChars.title: Block budget (characters)
budgetChars.description: How much exact detail to append after each compaction summary. About 4 characters per token; it stays in context until the next compaction.

recall.title: Recall tool
recall.description: Archive every tool output and what each compaction drops (under <config>/amnesia/archive/<session>/), and give the agent a recall tool to search them.

autoRecall.title: Attach lost messages to new prompts
autoRecall.description: After a compaction, when a prompt you send shares rare words with messages the compaction replaced, attach a few of those messages verbatim beside it (the agent sees them, you don't). Needs the recall tool.

lossIndex.title: Name what didn't fit
lossIndex.description: When more was dropped than the block can hold, spend part of it naming the rest ("acme-billing (staging port, ticket)") so the agent knows to look it up with recall. Needs the recall tool.
